description: Set the monthly sales target of one outpost (seller × marketplace) for a calendar month. Owners/admins only. vat says whether the target is VAT included (inclusa, default, same basis as the data) or excluded (esclusa: the cockpit then flags it yellow because it compares different bases). status: proposto (default) | validato | concordato; changing the numbers of a validato/concordato target without passing status puts it back to proposto. Only validato/concordato targets drive the projection light. Confirm amount, month and VAT with the user before saving.

confirm_id.description: Token di conferma ritornato dall'anteprima. Ripassa lo STESSO payload + confirm_id per eseguire davvero la scrittura.

name: set_cockpit_target
